text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Well, well, Verxina! Heard today's your 
birthday, yeah? Happy birthday!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah! Let's do a comedy routine to 
celebrate your birthday! You and me, 
'Golshi & Vilsi'!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
(...Golshi-san is saying weird things 
again, isn't she?)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
(Then again, giving a comeback would just 
play into her hands. In that case—)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I don't mind. But I don't really have much 
interest in playing the funny man or the 
straight man.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
If all I have to do is stand next to you, 
Golshi-san, I'd be happy to form a duo. 
What do you say?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"You're gonna play both the straight man 
and the funny guy all by yourself while I 
just stand here spacing out? Ha...!! What 
an interesting woman."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
In that case, double down!! I'll do 
side-to-side jumps around ya and give ya a 
full-on binaural comedy routine!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The Golshi Theater is accelerating! Don't 
you dare get thrown off by this speed, ya 
hear?!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Yes, please don't worry about it. I'll 
keep clinging on with everything I've got.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
(...Oh boy. Maybe I went about teasing 
them the wrong way.)
